target: Violate HACKDAC_p12: it must never happen that passchk is not asserted while correct counter is <= 31 (password check counter not reset after successful check).

milestones.description: System reset applied, JTAG TAP reset asserted
Reset released, JTAG TAP reset deasserted, correct counter initialized to zero
Violation: passchk cleared but correct counter not reset (correct <= 31 after successful check)
